title: The Central square of the town
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：central　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 central 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the keeper wrote of ① a central square of the town in the calendar, and everybody in the tower said at once that it was ② more central than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the central ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most central square of the town anybody in the tower had ever seen, or so the calendar for January 1959 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too central to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the traveller who had come to help; the central ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a central figure in the story, and said that no traveller in his right mind would call it ⑥ as central as the figure in the story they had once had in the old tower. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was central or not, and he said so.

By 1972 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the calendar. What the line asked for was ⑦ something central, and nothing besides. The traveller from the next tower called the whole plan ⑧ quite central; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the calendar kept the names of the central ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1975, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another central square of the town in the same calendar, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more central than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most central figure in the story in the whole tower, she said in 1977, was the one she could never quite name; the central ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 中心（前置定语 a central square of the town：1965 年守夜人在年历里记下的那件中心的广场）
B. adj. 中心／主要（比较级 more central than：文中两处，一处比镇中心的广场，一处比预想）
C. adj. 中心／主要（最高级 the most central：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 中心（表语 too central to do：母亲觉得它太中心，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 主要（前置定语 a central figure in the story：叔叔把整件事称作一桩主要的核心人物）
F. adj. 主要（同级比较 as central as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩故事里的核心人物相比）
G. adj. 主要（后置定语 something central：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 主要（受程度副词修饰 quite central：那位过路人的评价）

items.q: a central square of the town
the most central square of the town anybody
a central figure in the story
The most central figure in the story in

answers.why: central 意为“中心”，1965 年守夜人在年历里记下的是“一件中心的广场”，此处作前置定语 a central square of the town。
central 意为“中心”，此处用比较级 more central than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
central 意为“中心”，年历上 一月 那行字说它是钟楼里最中心的一件，故用最高级 the most central square of the town。
central 意为“中心”，母亲认为这件东西“太中心了，谁也用不上”，too central to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
central 意为“主要”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩主要的核心人物”，此处作前置定语 a central figure in the story。
central 意为“主要”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩故事里的核心人物一样主要”，同级比较用 as central as。
central 意为“主要”，年历上那半行字要的是“主要的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something central。
central 意为“主要”，邻钟楼来的那位过路人认为这套计划“相当主要”，quite 修饰原级 central。
central 意为“主要”，1975 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要主要”，故用比较级 more central than。
central 意为“主要”，母亲 1977 年说的是“整个钟楼里最主要的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most central figure in the story。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1965 年，守夜人在年历里记下了一件中心的广场。（a central square of the town）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更中心。（more central than …）
母亲觉得它太中心，谁也用不上。（too central to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩主要的核心人物。（a central figure in the story）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩故事里的核心人物一样主要。（as central as …）
到了 1972 年，年历上只剩半行字：要的是一件主要的东西。（something central）
answers: In 1965 the keeper wrote of a central square of the town in the calendar.
Everybody said it was more central than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too central to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a central figure in the story.
He said nobody would call it as central as the figure in the story they had once had.
By 1972 the calendar asked for nothing but something central.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 central 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1965 the keeper wrote of a central square of the town in the calendar, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most central square of the town in the tower, or so the calendar says.
My mother thought it too central to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a central figure in the story, and nobody argued with him.
The traveller from the next tower called the plan quite central, and everybody laughed.
The central ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
